description: A sprite sheet of NINE separate game UI skill icons arranged in a 3 by 3 grid, in this order left to right then top to bottom, each centered in its own cell: a steel sword sweeping a wide fan-shaped arc of orange flames; a sword slash releasing a dragon-shaped blue water jet forward; small green wind blades orbiting in a ring around an upright sword; a frost-crusted sword cleaving one wide icy cyan arc; a sword driven point-down into the ground, a crack running forward; a single upright steel longsword with a gold crossguard; a bold crimson diamond gem with sharp gold rays bursting out; a pale teal crescent moon above one flat calm mirror line; a round gem glowing with swirling red, blue and green magic. Color theme: mixed set: each sword keeps its own element colour (fire orange, water blue, wind green, ice cyan, earth brown); the four spare icons are plain steel, crimson-gold, teal and tri-colour. Chunky pixel art icons in the same style as the reference, thick dark outline, soft cel shading, bold readable silhouettes, every icon fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background with wide empty space around it, no text, no letters, no numbers, no frames, no borders

style_image.usage_description: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky pixel art UI icons, thick dark outline, soft cel shading, one icon centered per grid cell on magenta. Do not copy these objects or their colors.
